about: Shared test values for the site and the apps, so each side checks itself against the same numbers (docs/PARITY.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "החלטות יישור"). The site's tests and the apps' unit tests read this file; a change here changes all of them.

x3.about: X-3: the slope that paints a chosen run. line: along the run's draped line (relief.js drape, 18 m steps, top first), the height difference over the points 20 m before and 20 m after. ground: the bilinear height's central difference, 20 m each way along both axes. Degrees, from the site's own code after the rule (relief.js with 20 for 25 and for 15), 5.10.2026. Points in projected metres (x east, z south).

x4.about: X-4: which members share one flight card in the group's page. The key: direction (out or back), date, and the flight number normalised (capitals, no spaces or dashes); only without a flight number, the two airports (capitals). A row with a number and one without never meet. Each case: the outbound legs of the members' trips, and how many cards they make.
